name: SY1
author: fenderberg
tagline: A clone of the legendary Synth1 VST: one, two or four sounds at once
description: SY1 is a clone of the legendary Synth1 VST for the M-VAVE FM-1. It plays Synth1's .sy1 patches with its 99 parameters, and every parameter can be edited on the FM-1 itself. Three modes: one synth, bitimbral (two sounds) and quad-timbral (four sounds), with the sounds split between the left and right outputs for working with devices such as the Novation Circuit Tracks, whose macro knobs are mapped on every part. 256 sounds are on the device from the first boot, 3,000+ more are in the Patch Manager, and more than 20,000 Synth1 sounds can be found online.
credits: Built on fm1-base and felucca-bsp. The parameter laws are oxo_synth2's measurements of Synth1 (MIT, Francois Chabloz). Not affiliated with Daichi Laboratory.
